Tonkotsu Ramen.note: Pork broth and chashu; wheat noodles; ajitama egg is soy-sauce marinated (soy + wheat); sesame.

Shoyu Ramen.note: Bonito dashi and naruto fish cake = fish; soy tare = soy + wheat; wheat noodles; pork chashu; ajitama egg.

Miso Ramen.note: Miso = soy; wheat noodles; butter = milk; sesame; minced pork.

Spicy Tantanmen.note: Sesame paste; crushed peanuts; wheat noodles; tantanmen tare is sesame paste with soy sauce (soy, labelled from standard recipe). Pork. Very spicy.

Chicken Paitan Ramen.note: Wheat noodles; soy-braised chashu = soy + wheat; egg. Stated no pork, mirin or sake, so the halal-friendly ramen.

Yuzu Shio Ramen.note: Asari clams = molluscs; wheat noodles. Menma is customarily seasoned in soy sauce, so soy is labelled (judgement call). No pork or alcohol listed.

Tsukemen.note: Wheat noodles; niboshi (dried sardine) = fish; ajitama egg (soy marinade); pork.

Vegan Shoyu Ramen.note: Kombu/shiitake broth, no bonito; soy tare = soy + wheat; wheat noodles; tofu. Mirin is alcohol, so vegan but not halal.

Gluten-Free Chicken Ramen.note: Rice noodles; gluten-free tamari = soy only; egg marinated in tamari. No wheat.

Pan-fried Gyoza.note: Pork; wheat wrapper; soy-vinegar dip = soy + wheat; chilli oil on the side (label 1).

Vegetable Gyoza.note: Wheat wrapper; tofu; sesame oil. Glass noodles no gluten (wrapper has it anyway).

Chicken Karaage.note: Soy sauce = soy + wheat; Japanese mayo = egg; sake = alcohol, not halal. Potato starch has no gluten.

Chashu Don.note: Pork chashu; tare = soy + wheat; onsen egg; sesame.

Ajitama.note: Sounds vegetarian (just an egg) but marinated in the pork chashu braising liquid; soy sauce = soy + wheat; mirin and pork, not halal.

Takoyaki.note: Octopus = molluscs; wheat batter; egg and mayo; bonito flakes = fish; takoyaki sauce is Worcestershire-style (fish + gluten, rule i) with soy.

Agedashi Tofu.note: Sounds vegetarian but the dashi is bonito = fish; soy broth = soy + wheat; tofu.

Wakame Salad.note: Sesame seeds; soy sauce = soy + wheat. A little chilli.

Matcha Mochi.note: Glutinous rice has no gluten; red bean is not an allergen; stated no dairy.

Warabi Mochi.note: Kinako = roasted soybean flour. Bracken starch, no gluten.

Matcha Cheesecake.note: Cream cheese; baked cheesecake contains egg; digestive biscuit = wheat.

Iced Hojicha Oat Latte.note: Dairy-free, but oat milk = oats = gluten (v3 rule).

Genmaicha.note: Green tea and roasted rice; no gluten.

Asahi Draft.note: Beer = barley malt = gluten; alcohol, not halal.
